summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest) + frontend (Playwright E2E) testing of the Gantt System. Covered project/activity/incident CRUD, predecessor cascade, FS scheduling, incident delay propagation, stats, _id leak prevention, and full UI workflow including the canonical Feb 1 / A(3d) → B(5d, +3 delay) → C(2d) scenario. 15/15 backend tests pass. Frontend E2E passes end-to-end with correct dates and stats (Original 10d, Modified 13d, Δ 3d).
critical_code_review_comments: compute_gantt: schedule_slip_days uses (max_mod-min_mod) - (max_orig-min_orig); correct only because both share the same project_start. If a future change makes baselines diverge this could mislead. Consider summing per-activity (modified_end - original_end) >=0 contributions instead.
GET /api/incidents currently returns ALL incidents when no filter is given; consider requiring at least project_id or activity_id to avoid unbounded responses in multi-project deployments.

Project model accepts start_date as a free string. Adding Pydantic validation (e.g. constr regex YYYY-MM-DD or date type) would prevent runtime ValueError in compute_gantt if a malformed value is ever inserted.
DELETE endpoints (project/activity/incident) always return 200 with success:true even when the id does not exist; returning 404 in that case is more REST-correct.
_topological_order silently drops cyclic dependencies; the API does not warn the user. Consider returning a 400 if cycles are detected on activity create/update.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (project CRUD, activities CRUD, incidents CRUD, Gantt tabs, stats, propagation)

seed_data_creation: Test creates and cleans up TEST_GanttProject with activities A/B/C and one incident; test_delete_project_cascades creates and removes its own project. Frontend run created and deleted TEST_E2E_Gantt project.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_gantt_api.py covers all endpoints + canonical scheduling scenario (start 2026-02-01 with A=3d, B=5d preds=A, C=2d preds=B; incident on B 3d -> C ends 2026-02-13, schedule_slip_days=3). Reuse this file for regression. Frontend uses data-testid attributes everywhere; key ones: create-project-btn, project-name-input, project-start-date, submit-project-btn, open-new-activity-btn, activity-name-input, activity-duration-input, pred-option-{id}, submit-activity-btn, open-new-incident-btn, incident-activity-select, incident-reason-input, incident-days-input, submit-incident-btn, tab-activities/incidents/original/modified/compare, stat-activities/incidents/delay-days/duration.
